content:
maria: Hi team — noticed HealthCo private deploy renewal invoice INV-2026-04523 has duplicate platform_fee line and support_tier = Standard but contract says Enterprise. Screenshot attached.
sam: can you paste the invoice lines here?
maria: sure
```
INV-2026-04523
line 1: PLATFORM_FEE_MONTHLY x12 $120,000
line 2: PLATFORM_FEE_MONTHLY x12 $120,000  <-- duplicate?
line 3: SUPPORT_STANDARD x12 $24,000
line 4: PRIVATE_DEPLOY_LICENSE 1YR $0
TOTAL: $264,000
```
leo: yikes, duplicate platform fee indeed. Looks like an automation bug in the billing pipeline that duplicated recurring when we converted to committed seat sku. :eyes: 
invoice-bot: detected invoice anomaly INV-2026-04523 — duplicate line items; auto-flagged for manual review.
alex: tagging @priya for sign-off on credit note and reissue. Need approval for credit of $120,000 and to set support tier to Enterprise (delta $+16,000) — net credit ~$104,000.
priya: on phone for next 30m, but tentative +1 to credit and reissue. Please prepare draft credit note and corrected invoice.
tara: pls confirm if this affects true-up calculation for their renewal in July. HealthCo had a mid-year true-up clause.
maria: yes, their midyear true-up uses invoiced platform_fee as baseline. We should recalc and adjust the true-up schedule. I'll run the usage vs committed report.
sam: ping Customer Success to notify customer preemptively. tara, can you handle comms if we reissue?
tara: will draft a short note: apologize, explain duplicate, confirm credit & corrected invoice, and attach new invoice. will CC legal if support tier change needs amendment.
leo: ops steps: 1) create credit CN-2026-0012 for $120,000 2) create invoice INV-2026-04524 with single platform_fee line and SUPPORT_ENTERPRISE at $40,000 3) run true-up recalc job `billing:recalc_trueup --customer healthco --since 2026-01-01` 4) verify accounting entries.
alex: @leo please hold on creating credit until Priya confirms; we need to include note about netting support tier delta into the credit memo.
priya: confirm. approve credit for $120,000 and reissue invoice. finance to include explanatory memo. I approve net adjustment and true-up recalc.
alex: doing now — raised credit CN-2026-0012 (pending) and draft INV-2026-04524 ready for send. tagging @invoice-bot to attach memo template.
invoice-bot: attached memo template: "Credit issued due to duplicate platform fee; support tier corrected to Enterprise per contract; net credit applied to renewal true-up." :white_check_mark:
maria: thanks all. tara, please send comms after I confirm the recalc numbers.
tara: will wait. ETA to customer email: today EOD.
leo: note for audit: root cause is a mapping edge-case when migrating committed sku data. I'll open an internal ticket in eng-billing.
sam: thanks team. healthco renewal contact asked for an estimated corrected total — maria, can you share once recalc done?
maria: will post numbers in this thread when ready. :thumbsup:
